name: Kirkwood Farmers' Market
description: In 150 E. Argonne Dr., MO, Kirkwood Farmers' Market raises Pumpkins, Corn, Herbs, Honey, and Eggs on a family-run farm. The harvest is typically at its peak in autumn. Visitors can find seasonal produce and farm-grown goods through autumn. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Sep – Nov in this growing zone.
